Q: Eigen Matrix <-> Vector manipulations A:

I think you want ref_landmarks.rowwise() - ref_offset.transpose();, (or ref_landmarks.array().rowwise() - ref_offset.array().transpose();)

The error YOU_CANNOT_MIX_ARRAYS_AND_MATRICES was meant to be a clue about the use of array(), not the mixing of vectors and matricies.

Q: Cant escape IF loop even when conditions are false C# A:

answer cannot be both "1" and "2" and so:

answer != "1" || answer != "2"

Will always be true.
Therefore the whole condition in the first if will always be true and you will never execute the else clauses.

You need to use && (AND) between them to check if they are neither:

//------------------------------------------------------vv----------------
if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(answer) || (answer != "1" && answer != "2"))

(I also added parenthesis to make it more readable although they are not strictly needed due to operator precedence).

Q: Is it safe to directly dereference mmap'ed I/O memory in userspace (e.g., via UIO)? A:

One other thing that userspace register access code needs to be aware of is that readw(), writew() (and ioread16(), iowrite16()), etc. (and also inw(), outw() etc. for I/O port address space) calls in the kernel automatically do endian conversions when accessing hardware registers in PCI regions for big-endian CPU architectures, because PCI is considered to be a little-endian bus architecture.

Q: PHP get number of week for month A:

Carbon now has a property with the number of week for a date:

$date = new Carbon('2026-04-20');
$date->weekOfMonth;       //3: ceil(20/7)
$date->weekNumberInMonth; //4: number of week in a calendar

Q: How to change app text or background color in Android Studio? A: 
Using Jetpack Compose (Modern Kotlin)
If you see @Composable functions in your MainActivity.kt, you are using Compose. 
You change colors directly in the Kotlin code.

Change Text Color -- Inside your Text component, use the color parameter:

Text(
    text = "Hello Android!",
    color = Color.Blue // Or Color(0xFF0000FF) for hex
)

Change Background Color -- Wrap your content in a Surface or a Box and set the color or background modifier:

Surface(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    color = Color.White // Sets the background to white
) {
    Text(text = "Hello Android!", color = Color.Black)
}
